title: A conditional charged Penrose bound in spatial dimension at least four
exact_target: Assuming the stated neutral spacetime Penrose input in every spatial dimension $n\geq 4$, do the smooth one-ended purely electric charged DEC exteriors of the manuscript satisfy $m\geq |Q|$ and $X_A\leq m+\operatorname{sqrt}(m^2-Q^2)$, with $X_A=(A_min/\omega _{n-1})^((n-2)/(n-1))$ and the manuscript-normalized total electric charge Q? Include strict positivity and timelikeness of ADM mass and the large-area branch $m\geq (X_A+Q^2/X_A)/2$ for $X_A>|Q|$.
